critique: The luminous branching coral that calcifies, blooms with polyp nodes, and dissolves beneath drifting plankton, wireframe shrimp, terraced seabed, and live “CALCIFY” telemetry creates a vivid, unusually seamless cyber-nature ecosystem. The uniform teal-magenta glow, scanline grid, and conventional corner-ruler HUD risk flattening the reef into familiar cyberpunk styling; vary coral textures and bioluminescent behaviors, and make the tiny guinea-pig anomaly legible enough to become a genuinely surprising narrative intrusion.
